in_arabic.name: شميلة
in_arabic.meaning: المرأة ذات الخَلق الحسن والشكل الجميل
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم شميلة مشتق من الجذر العربي (ش-م-ل) الذي يعني الجمال والكمال. يشير الاسم إلى المرأة التي تتميز بخَلقها الحسن وشكلها الجميل. ورد هذا الاسم في بعض المصادر العربية القديمة كوصف للمرأة الصالحة ذات الأخلاق الحميدة.

in_urdu.name: شمائلہ

in_english.name: Shumailah
in_english.long_meaning: The name Shumailah originates from the Arabic root (ش-م-ل), which denotes beauty and completeness. It refers to a woman who is not only physically beautiful but also possesses good character and morals. Historically, this name has been used in various Muslim cultures to signify a woman of virtue and beauty. The name carries a spiritual significance, reflecting the Islamic values of inner and outer beauty.

data.cultural_impact: The name Shumailah, meaning "moonlight" or "night beauty," holds a significant cultural significance in many Muslim communities for various reasons. In some cultures, the moon represents knowledge, guidance, and the divine; as such, a child named Shumailah may be seen as a symbol of wisdom and knowledge. Furthermore, in many poetic and artistic traditions, the beauty of the night is often evoked, and naming a child Shumailah may be seen as a testament to the exquisiteness of the night and the creator's artistry.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Shumailah carries deeper meanings and significance. Moonlight symbolizes the light of Allah, which illuminates the path for believers in the darkest of nights. As such, the name Shumailah may be seen as a reminder of the divine support and guidance that believers can receive from Allah at all times, even when things may appear challenging or uncertain. Additionally, the name may serve as a reminder of the beauty and wonder of creation, as reflected in the verse from the Quran, "Verily, in the creation of the heavens and the earth and the alternation of the night and the day are signs for those of understanding" (Quran 3:190). Thus, a spiritual significance of the name Shumailah can be understood as a reminder to seek knowledge, guidance, and wisdom from Allah, and to appreciate the beauty and intricacy of His creation.
